[[Winter Park, Florida]] | former_school(s)= | awards = SEC All-Freshman Team[http://www.secsports.com/index.php?s=&url_channel_id=3&url_article_id=10650&url_subchannel_id=&change_well_id=2 SEC announces awards voted by coaches] 2011 SEC Player of the Year http://www.secdigitalnetwork.com/NEWS/tabid/473/Article/222025/2011-sec-mens-hoops-awards-announced.aspx }} '''Chandler Parsons''', (born October 25, 1988) is an [[United States|American]] [[basketball]] player. He attends the [[University of Florida]] where he is currently in his senior year. ==High School Career== Parsons attended [[Lake Howell High School]] with fellow freshman Gator [[Nick Calathes]]. Together they helped their team win the 2007 5A State Title in [[Florida]].[http://www.sunsportstv.com/columnist.jhtml?method=getArticle&article.id=204 SunSports & FSN | Your Florida Sports Networks] ==College career== Parsons began his collegiate career in the 2007-08 season for the [[Florida Gators]]. In his freshmen season Parsons played in 36 games averaging 8.1 points per game and 4.0 rebounds per game, but the Gators failed to make the NCAA Tournament. During the 2008-09 season, Parsons saw more playing time and his scoring, rebounding and assists all improved. The Gators once again failed to make the tournament though. In Parson's junior season, he averaged 12.4 points per game, 6.9 rebounds per game and 2.6 assists per game. The Gators made the NCAA Tournament, but lost to [[BYU]] in the first round.{{cite web|url=http://sports.espn.go.com/ncb/player/profile?playerId=36383|title=ESPN- Chandler Parsons player profile}} During the 2010-11 regular season, Parsons averaged 11.4 points and 7.8 rebounds in 33 minutes a game while leading the Gators to the best regular season record in the SEC. On January 3, 2010, Parsons hit a seventy-five foot shot with no time left on the clock in overtime to give the Gators a one point victory over North Carolina State.{{cite web|url=http://gatorzone.com/story.php?id=17186|title=Parsons' Buzzer Beater Downs N.C. State, 62-61 |accessdate=4 January 2010}} Later in the season on January 23, the Gators trailed South Carolina by 1 when Parsons hit a three-point shot to give the Gators the win.{{cite web|url=http://gatorzone.com/story.php?id=17302|title=Parsons' Buzzer Beater Leads UF Over South Carolina, 58-56|accessdate=24 January 2010}} On March 8, 2011, he was named the 2011 SEC Player of the Year. http://www.secdigitalnetwork.com/NEWS/tabid/473/Article/222025/2011-sec-mens-hoops-awards-announced.aspx The Gators also made the NCAA Tournament for the second year in a row. In the first three rounds of the tournament, the Gators beat [[UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball|UC Santa Barbara]], [[UCLA Bruins men's basketball|UCLA]] and [[BYU Cougars men's basketball|BYU]]. In the Elite Eight, the Gators lost to [[Butler Bulldogs men's basketball|Butler]]. Parsons was picked to the Fifth Team All-America by [[Fox Sports]].{{cite news|first=Jeff|last=Goodman|url=http://msn.foxsports.com/collegebasketball/story/duke-blue-devils-notre-dame-fighting-irish-represented-postseason-honors-030711|title=Goodman's 2010-11 All-America teams|work=[[Fox Sports]]||publisher=Fox Sports Interactive Media|date=Mar 7, 2011|accessdate=June 21, 2011}} ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Southeastern Conference Men's Basketball Player of the Year}} {{Persondata | NAME = Parsons, Chandler | ALTERNATIVE NAMES = | SHORT DESCRIPTION = | DATE OF BIRTH = 1988-10-25 | PLACE OF BIRTH = | DATE OF DEATH = | PLACE OF DEATH = }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Parsons, Chandler}} [[Category:1988 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:Basketball players from Florida]] [[Category:Florida Gators men's basketball players]] [[Category:People from Winter Park, Florida]] {{1980s-US-basketball-bio-stub}}
